title: Craftable Dripstone
description: This datapack adds a simple way of crafting pointed dripstone, using 5 stone
body:
# Craftable Pointed Dripstone

This datapack adds a crafting recipe for dripstone using 5 stone, so players don't have to go to a cave to get it.

<details>
<summary>Crafting recipe</summary>


![The crafting recipe is as follows, from left to right, then top to bottom: stone stone stone, blank stone blank, blank stone blank](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f19eca2a9ee86d263a336350bb8618c02cee800.png)

</details>

## Supported versions:

- 26.1.x
- 1.21.11

Will be updated when new versions come out
